wiki.title: Caroline Menjivar
wiki.extract: Caroline Menjivar (born 1988 or 1989) is an American politician and United States Marine Corps veteran, who has served as a member of the California State Senate since 2022. A member of the Democratic Party, she represents the 20th district. She became the first LGBTQ legislator to represent San Fernando Valley.
